articles.title: Erika Hammond and Ankur Jain combined net worth 2026: Inside the wealth, earnings of the former WWE Diva, Rumble Boxing co-creator and her husband
articles.summary: WWE News: Erika Hammond has built a career across professional wrestling, fitness and television. She first gained attention through her work as a WWE performer.
articles.body: Erika Hammond has built a career across professional wrestling, fitness and television. She first gained attention through her work as a WWE performer. Later she moved into the boutique fitness industry. Her career later expanded into business and reality television, helping her become a familiar name beyond sports entertainment.Hammond is also known for her connection to the luxury fitness industry and her work with Rumble Boxing. She has developed fitness programs. She built a strong public profile through her business ventures. Her personal life also attracted attention after she married entrepreneur Ankur Jain in 2024, linking her to one of the biggest names in financial technology.Erika Hammond and Ankur Jain combined net worth 2026 Erika Hammond has an estimated net worth of $100 million, according to celebrity net worth. However, it is important to note that this estimate is largely connected to communal marital wealth following her 2024 marriage to Ankur Jain. Jain is the founder and CEO of Bilt Rewards and has an estimated net worth of $3.4 billion. Together they have a combined net worth of $3.5 billion.Hammond established herself in the fitness world after her professional wrestling career. She became involved in the growing boutique fitness industry. Where specialized studios offer high-energy and community-focused workout experiences.One of her biggest career achievements came through Rumble Boxing. Hammond was involved in creating the boxing-inspired fitness concept. It combines boxing exercises with high-intensity interval training. The brand became popular for its energetic classes, music and immersive studio atmosphere.Rumble expanded into several cities. It became a recognizable name in the boutique fitness market. Hammond’s work with the company helped strengthen her reputation as a fitness entrepreneur.She also worked with Equinox, the luxury gym and fitness company. Hammond developed specialized training programs and fitness concepts for the high-end fitness market.Before entering the fitness business, Hammond worked in professional wrestling. She gained exposure as a WWE Diva. She appeared in televised events and promotional activities.Although her wrestling career was relatively short, it gave Hammond valuable experience in entertainment and media. It also helped her build the public profile that later supported her work in fitness and television.Hammond eventually expanded into reality television. She joined the cast of The Real Housewives of New York City during its sixteenth season. Her appearance introduced her business background and personal life to a much wider audience.Her personal life became another major part of her public profile in 2024. Hammond married Ankur Jain in April of that year. The couple held their wedding in Egypt near the pyramids as part of an elaborate multi-day celebration.Jain founded Bilt Rewards, a financial technology company focused on rewards for renters. Through his business career, he has accumulated a multibillion-dollar fortune.Hammond’s career therefore combines sports entertainment, fitness entrepreneurship and television. articles.title: "That’s it, I’m divorcing him"- Former WWE Women's Champion considered ending her marriage
articles.summary: A shocking revelation was made by former WWE Women's Champion, Carmella, who is no longer a part of the company.
articles.body: A shocking revelation was made by former WWE Women's Champion, Carmella, who is no longer a part of the company. She is married to current commentator Corey Graves. However, in a turn of events, the Princess of Staten Island recalled one of the hardest parts of her life that pushed her to the edge, and she actually considered divorcing Graves.What happened that former WWE star Carmella considered ending her marriage?Carmella had gone through an ectopic pregnancy, which was one of the most painful and hardest times of her life. Speaking on her Hot Mom S**t podcast, the former SmackDown Women's Champion revealed that Graves initially did not understand the seriousness of the situation. "I’m in the hospital and I’m getting transported by ambulance to another hospital, and he was just like, ‘Oh, I have to go home,’ because his son was getting a haircut.”Upon hearing that, Mella was left shocked at her husband's behavior in such a serious situation. However, she said that Graves understood all the risks associated with ectopic pregnancy a few days later. Furthermore, Mella also spoke about Graves feeling guilty about not going on a work trip during that time even when WWE had granted him time off. She said, "He was, like, guilty about going to work—I mean, about not going to work. He’s like, ‘Oh, I have to be home with you, but, like, I feel like I should be going to work.’ And I’m like, ‘No, like, you need to be home with me.’”Everything that piled up on Carmella in regards to Corey Graves during her potentially life-threatening pregnancy pushed her so far that the thought of divorcing him actually crossed her mind.“If you’re going to be committed to this relationship, which I—I wasn’t like, ‘That’s it, I’m divorcing him,’ because, I mean, don’t get me wrong, I definitely thought it for a minute. I was like, ‘Does he not even understand that he has to sit with me when I’m sick?’Are Carmella and Corey Graves still together?The couple fought through the difficult situation, and Carmella admitted it made their relationship stronger. On the other hand, while Graves is still a part of WWE, Carmella's contract expired last year amid a hiatus due to pregnancy.
